definition: Additional items or equipment associated with a particular thing.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: In the first place he must immediately deliver up the pistol which he boasted of, with all its appurtenances.
example_sentence: The camping trip needed a tent and all its baffling appurtenances.
